_help: Owner's pricing rules. Every supplier price in the catalog is the WHOLESALE COST to us; the customer price = cost x (1 + markup%). Values marked confirmed=false are placeholders until the owner sends the real ones - change them here, no code change, the app picks them up immediately.

markup._help: Markup on wholesale cost per business (customer price = cost x (1 + percent/100)). Applies to products, supplier assembly fees, countertop material and countertop services. PLACEHOLDER 35% until the owner confirms.

sales_tax.not_taxed: Countertops (fabricated + installed), installation, assembly, delivery, modifications (services).
sales_tax._help: 7% on products (cabinets, sinks, faucets, handles ... per the owner). No tax on countertops. When the quote includes installation, the installed items are not taxed.

installation._help: PLACEHOLDER install price sheet (price per unit + labor minutes per unit, used for the time estimate). Replace with the owner's install price sheet. Countertops are already fabricated + installed in their price. Categories not listed here are not installed by us.

flooring._help: Ask whether the customer's area already includes waste; if not, recommend adding this percent.
